scope: read-only catalog and Storage column definitions only; no stored objects or business rows

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX client_document_signatures_document_id_signer_role_key ON public.client_document_signatures USING btree (document_id, signer_role)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX client_document_signatures_pkey ON public.client_document_signatures USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX client_documents_pkey ON public.client_documents USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_client_documents_client ON public.client_documents USING btree (client_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_client_documents_intake ON public.client_documents USING btree (tenant_id, client_id, intake_document_id) WHERE (intake_document_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE INDEX idx_client_documents_portal_proofs ON public.client_documents USING btree (tenant_id, client_id, created_at DESC) WHERE ((portal_visible = true) AND (category = 'leistungsnachweis'::text))
CREATE INDEX idx_client_documents_service_record ON public.client_documents USING btree (tenant_id, service_record_id) WHERE (service_record_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cs_document_request_signatures_pkey ON public.cs_document_request_signatures USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX portal_signature_captures_pkey ON public.portal_signature_captures USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_portal_signature_captures_document ON public.portal_signature_captures USING btree (tenant_id, document_id, signed_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX portal_uploads_pkey ON public.portal_uploads USING btree (id)

CREATE INDEX idx_portal_uploads_pending ON public.portal_uploads USING btree (tenant_id, status) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['hochgeladen'::portal_upload_status, 'wird_geprueft'::portal_upload_status]))
CREATE INDEX idx_portal_uploads_request ON public.portal_uploads USING btree (portal_request_id) WHERE (portal_request_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_portal_uploads_tenant_client ON public.portal_uploads USING btree (tenant_id, client_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_portal_uploads_employee ON public.portal_uploads USING btree (tenant_id, employee_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (employee_id IS NOT NULL)
